title: Petya and Staircases
statementMd:
Little boy Petya loves stairs very much. But he is bored from simple going up and down them — he loves jumping over several stairs at a time. As he stands on some stair, he can either jump to the next one or jump over one or two stairs at a time. But some stairs are too dirty and Petya doesn't want to step on them.

Now Petya is on the first stair of the staircase, consisting of $*n*$ stairs. He also knows the numbers of the dirty stairs of this staircase. Help Petya find out if he can jump through the entire staircase and reach the last stair number $*n*$ without touching a dirty stair once.

One has to note that anyway Petya should step on the first and last stairs, so if the first or the last stair is dirty, then Petya cannot choose a path with clean steps only.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤ 3000$) — the number of stairs in the staircase and the number of dirty stairs, correspondingly. The second line contains $*m*$ **different** space-separated integers $*d*_{1}, *d*_{2}, ..., *d*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) — the numbers of the dirty stairs (in an arbitrary order).

## Output

Print "`YES`" if Petya can reach stair number $*n*$, stepping only on the clean stairs. Otherwise print "`NO`".
statementZhMd:
小男孩 Petya 非常喜欢楼梯。不过，简单地上下楼梯让他感到无聊——他喜欢一次跳过几级楼梯。当他站在某一级楼梯上时，可以跳到下一级，也可以一次跳过一或两级楼梯。但有些楼梯太脏了，Petya 不想踩上去。

现在 Petya 站在由 $*n*$ 级楼梯组成的楼梯的第一级上。他还知道这座楼梯中所有脏楼梯的编号。请帮助 Petya 判断，他是否能够在一次都不踩到脏楼梯的情况下，跳完整座楼梯并到达编号为 $*n*$ 的最后一级楼梯。

需要注意的是，无论如何 Petya 都必须踩在第一级和最后一级楼梯上。因此，如果第一级或最后一级楼梯是脏的，那么 Petya 就无法选择一条只经过干净楼梯的路径。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$，$0 ≤ *m* ≤ 3000$），分别表示楼梯的级数和脏楼梯的数量。第二行包含 $*m*$ 个**互不相同**的、以空格分隔的整数 $*d*_{1}, *d*_{2}, ..., *d*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），表示脏楼梯的编号，编号顺序任意。

## 输出格式

如果 Petya 能够只踩干净楼梯到达编号为 $*n*$ 的楼梯，输出 `YES`；否则输出 `NO`。
